systems.name: Acturis
systems.relevance_to_ardonagh: Ardonagh publicly disclosed migration of advisory sites onto Acturis, and third-party implementation notes list Acturis as one of Ardonagh's key PAS environments.
systems.api_gap: Acturis has partner-specific integrations, but no broadly available self-serve API for generic broker-side policy extraction workflows.

systems.name: Open GI Transactor
systems.relevance_to_ardonagh: Ardonagh implementation references include reconciliation and migration workstreams against Open GI PAS environments.
systems.api_gap: Open GI markets integration capabilities but does not expose a public developer portal with self-service API contracts suitable for direct tenant onboarding.

systems.name: RDT Landscape (Legacy / GEO)
systems.relevance_to_ardonagh: Midas Underwriting (Ardonagh group) was publicly documented migrating from RDT Landscape (legacy GEO system) to Open GI, making it relevant for historical book extraction.
systems.api_gap: Legacy deployment model and migration-focused usage indicate no practical modern, self-serve API path for retrospective policy extraction.
